campaign: Example theme: turn a weekend walk into a small game
rules: Give each account a clear purpose.
Tell different sides of one story instead of copying it.
Set frequency by capacity; allow yourself to reduce it.
Record metric sources and dates; never invent numbers.
Check the platform’s current rules before posting.
Keep client and partnership details out of public content.
